objective: Bring 3 Soothing Spices to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.

description: I like cooking.  Good swamp cooking.  Fried green frog legs and the like.
And for cooking, I need spice.  Soothing spice.  Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.
progress: Spice. We could all use some spice in our life. You agree?
completion: Ah, that's the spice! Now here's some swampy good stew.
